description:
"Cast forth a complex rune granting you and your group members Minor Resolve for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

You gain Minor Protection for |cffffff20|r seconds, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

The first time you are damaged while below 50% Health, Minor Protection is consumed to heal you for |cffffff3016|r Health, scaling off your Max Health, and gain |cffffff3300|r Armor and Crowd Control Immunity for |cffffff7|r seconds. This immunity can occur once every |cffffff30|r seconds."
